primary_model_and_method_sources.finding: Explicit public GPL source link; fetched release contains author-attributed EAM4 implementation and root GPL3 text.

EAM4 Ni(100) example: 392 Ni, four layers of 98, lateral periodicity, fixed bottom layer, 10 angstrom cutoff. These are implementation-documentation facts, not independently confirmed settings of the 2012 paper.
Describes later EAM4/5/6/7 family and differences between published formulas and original source. Current nihEAM6pot.f90 actually starts with an EAM7 wrapper and is not selected.
Names Truong/Truhlar/Garrett 1989, Truong/Truhlar 1990 and Wonchoba/Truhlar 1995–1998 model references.
